items: CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 9.3): Governor Otu Grants N450m Lifeline to SPAR Fire Victims; Sends Coffee Study Delegation to Uganda
EDO STATE (PSI 9.2): Governor Okpebholo Accelerates 83 Division Army Infrastructure; Special Court Delivers First Kidnapping Verdict
LAGOS STATE (PSI 9.1): Lagos Flags Off 2026 MICHD Program across Health Districts; LAWMA Arrests 14 Waste Offenders
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.9): Governor Otti Commissions 55-Room ORIS Signature Hotel in Aba; Mobilizes Youths for Air Force Recruitment
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 8.8): Governor Namadi Hosts Annual Forum of Jigawa Academics to Drive Evidence-Based Development
NIGER STATE (PSI 8.7): Gov. Bago Receives Federal Independent Panel, Taraba Governor, and Army GOC Over Custody Deaths
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.5): Adamawa Assures Completion of All Projects Before May 2027; Screens 600+ Israel Pilgrims
ONDO STATE (PSI 8.4): Ondo Physical Planning Ministry Seals Illegal Buildings Across Major Towns to Prevent Collapse
ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.3): Enugu Highlights Industrial Transformation as Haitech Haier Builds Global Electronics Factory
OSUN STATE (PSI 8.2): Osun Establishes Environmental Sanitation Taskforce; Clarifies UNIOSUN VC Tenure Legislation
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.1): PLAMWASSA Conducts SURWASH ODF Community Follow-Up; NFWP-SU Partners NIMC for Women's NIN
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.0): Zamfara Arabic Board Develops Standardized Tsangaya Curriculum for WAEC/NECO Integration
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 7.8): Governor Soludo Revives Abandoned Nnewi Mall Project, Hands Site to Contractor for 52-Week Completion
CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.3): Disbursed N25m each to 18 fire-affected business owners at SPAR Calabar, backed local vendors at the Pop-Up Market, and sent a delegation to Uganda to study coffee production.
EDO (PSI 9.2): Inspected land clearing and temporary facilities at Teboga for the Nigerian Army's 83 Division while the Special Criminal Court scheduled its first kidnapping judgment.
LAGOS (PSI 9.1): Flagged off the MICHD nutritional program in Health District I distributing food packs, hosted the National GBV Convening, and arrested 14 illegal waste dumpers.
ABIA (PSI 8.9): Commissioned a world-class 55-room hotel in Aba, urging returned diaspora investors to leverage city infrastructure gains, and opened Air Force recruitment portals.
JIGAWA (PSI 8.8): Hosted university scholars and researchers in Dutse to review evidence-based policy implementation and translate academic research into practical state development solutions.
NIGER (PSI 8.7): Hosted the Federal Independent Panel investigating 37 NSCDC custody deaths in Minna, alongside condolence visits from Taraba Governor Kefas and Army GOC Maj. Gen. Wase.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.5): Confirmed all ongoing roads will be completed before May 2027 following Chikila Road site inspection, convened ACSM health team, and screened 600+ Christian pilgrims.
ONDO (PSI 8.4): Deployed monitoring task forces across Akure, Ondo, Ikare, Owo, and Idanre, serving contravention notices and sealing illegal structures lacking approved layout plans.
ENUGU (PSI 8.3): Highlighted state industrial transformation as Haitech Haier Global establishes a high-tech electronics, appliance, and energy product assembly factory in Enugu.
OSUN (PSI 8.2): Inaugurated an Environmental Sanitation Task Force chaired by the Head of Service while clarifying legal frameworks behind the UNIOSUN Establishment Amendment Bill 2026.
PLATEAU (PSI 8.1): Executed a 6-day sanitation follow-up in Langtang North under SURWASH and partnered with NIMC to streamline NIN registration for unbanked Women Affinity Groups.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.0): Developed and submitted a standardized formal curriculum for Tsangaya Islamic schools to Governor Lawal to enable students to sit for WAEC/NECO exams.
ANAMBRA (PSI 7.8): Flagged off the completion of the Nnewi Mall project after 14 years of abandonment, handing the site to contractors for delivery within 52 weeks.
